coverage.value: Every Nation / Every Nation Campus (everynation.org, everynation.us) - domain: give.everynation.org
coverage.note: HIT. Public giving portal with per-person pages at give.everynation.org/donate/<first>-<last> (some at /category/missionaries/<surname>-<first>). Titles name the person, couple pages name both spouses. Org states missionaries complete Ministry Partnership Development with a 200-day initial support team, so Tier A. Portal claims 324 cross-cultural missionaries available to give to plus a large campus-missionary set; search surfaces only a fraction - this domain deserves a dedicated fetch/crawl pass, it is far from exhausted.

coverage.value: Student Mobilization campus subdomains - stumo.org (national staff.stumo.org login-gated, already dead)
coverage.note: One search as instructed. No <campus>.stumo.org/staff.html surfaced in search at all. What does exist is REGIONAL sites on their own domains with flat roster pages: heartlandstumo.org/staff/, ozarkstumo.org/staff, pioneerstumo.org/staff. No per-person giving slug, no individual names readable from URLs or titles - the rosters are rendered inside the page. Not a hit from search; worth a fetch pass on those three roster URLs, not another search.

Org-level only. searchministries.org/support/ is a single org support page, not per-person. ~60 staff across 23 cities, ECFA-accredited, HQ Fort Worth TX. No staff directory and no per-person giving slug surfaced; individual staff (e.g. an 'Area Director' title) appear only on third-party data-broker profiles (ZoomInfo/Datanyze), which are not citable as the person's own page. Needs a fetch pass on searchministries.org/support/ and any city pages.

Flat roster only: ocfusa.org/staff-directory/ exists as a single directory page; no per-person slug. FUNDING CHECK (as instructed, not assumed): OCF's own strategy document says field staff 'has taken an increasing responsibility for fundraising for their LOCAL MINISTRY needs' and directs donors to ocfusa.org/impact for 'key projects to fund' - that is ministry/project fundraising, NOT personal salary support. No OCF statement found that staff raise their own salaries. On that evidence OCF is Tier B, not Tier A. Do not grade Tier A without a direct statement; re-check on a fetch pass of the staff directory and any 'support a staff member' page.

No per-person surface. Giving is org- and centre-level: christianunion.org/get-involved/give (a 'Development Team' page and per-Ministry-Centre funds, e.g. the Columbia Ministry Center raised $503K from 220 partners). FUNDING CHECK (as instructed): Christian Union Ministry Fellows appear to be SALARIED, not support-raised - employee reviews describe 'good compensation ... for those in a Ministry Fellow position' and the org fundraises centrally per ministry centre rather than per staff member. No CU statement found requiring fellows to raise personal support. On that evidence Tier B, not Tier A. Note this is inferred from the giving structure plus review text; a fetch of CU's careers/Ministry Fellow page would settle it.

Greek IV is a ministry stream INSIDE InterVarsity, not a separate staff surface. Its own pages (greek.intervarsity.org, intervarsity.org/fm/greek/connect, /fm/greek/resources, intervarsity.org/taxonomy/term/866) are programme pages naming no staff. Giving runs through give.intervarsity.org, which offers 'staff' as a designation category but exposed no per-person staff slug in search. InterVarsity is already on WORKED.md (23 held). No separate Greek IV vein - do not re-buy.

Separate national giving site. Entry point is give.everynation.org.ph/supportamissionary.aspx - a .aspx form/search, not per-person slugs. Not a hit; the mineable surface is the global give.everynation.org instead.

NEGATIVE on tier, not just on surface. Nashville-based nonprofit with a small salaried/hourly staff (job postings on ZipRecruiter, delightministries.com/job-opportunities, ~9-12 employees); chapters are run by student leaders, not by support-raised staff. No staff directory, no per-person giving. Tier B at best - deprioritise.

Support-raised (Cru states full-time Inner City staff 'raise their own financial support'), so the TIER is right - but the SURFACE fails. Giving pages are opaque numeric IDs (give.cru.org/2812897, give.cru.org/2869364_2072) whose titles are generic fund names ('Stateside Missionary Staff Support', 'Help Missionary Staff'), not people. Per the numeric-ID rule these could never exceed medium and here they do not even name a person. City team pages (cru.org/us/en/communities/innercity/<city>/) are programme pages. Not mineable from search.

needs_review.issue: Tier grade contradicts the wave's default assumption for two named orgs
needs_review.finding: Officers' Christian Fellowship and Christian Union both look like SALARIED-staff organisations, not support-raised ones
needs_review.evidence: OCF's own strategy PDF (ocfusa.org/static/uploads/article-pdf/ocf_strategy_07-11.pdf) frames field-staff fundraising as being for 'local ministry needs' and points donors at project funding (ocfusa.org/impact); no personal-salary-support statement found. Christian Union fundraises per Ministry Centre (christianunion.org/columbia/ministry-center/, 220 partners / $503K) and employee reviews describe Ministry Fellows as receiving 'good compensation'.
needs_review.recommendation: Grade both Tier B unless a direct org statement says staff raise their own salaries. Both verdicts rest on indirect evidence (a strategy document and a giving structure), so if either org is ever re-probed, fetch ocfusa.org/staff-directory/ and Christian Union's Ministry Fellow careers page first and settle it on the org's own words.
